name: Fatoumata Ramos-Mensah
role: Target acquisition and fugitive recovery — bounty hunter
location: The Rookery — dense vertical housing, gang-controlled, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Fatoumata Ramos-Mensah is athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in GLMZ, the distinction is academic. At 27, there's something unfinished about her face, like a sculpture the artist walked away from — striking rather than beautiful. The chrome is visible — smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She grew up in the Narrows, where the walls are so close together you learn to fight in confined spaces or you learn to lose. She works as a bounty hunter out of The Rookery, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

she is not the most talented bounty hunter in GLMZ, but she might be the most stubborn, and in this city that's worth more.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
That their reputation is built on luck, not skill, and the luck is finite
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
core_desires: Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
Stability — a place to sleep that's the same place two nights running
coping_mechanisms: Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
blind_spots: Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Believes their trauma makes them special instead of recognizing it as damage to manage
psychology.secret: Fatoumata Ramos-Mensah once worked for corporate intelligence and still has a handler who calls in favors. Each favor erodes what's left of their independence.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Flat affect, monotone delivery. The content is terrifying but the voice never rises.
speech_patterns.cadence: Staccato bursts separated by calculating silences.
verbal_tics: Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
example_lines: "Everyone has a pattern. Patterns are addresses waiting to be read."
"I find people. Whether they're alive when I bring them back depends on their behavior."
"You can run. It's cardiovascular exercise for both of us."

story_hooks: Fatoumata Ramos-Mensah's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
A Tier 4 executive offers Fatoumata Ramos-Mensah a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Fatoumata Ramos-Mensah is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Fatoumata Ramos-Mensah functions as a connector — her work puts her in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving her naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons. Cranial bomb defuser — specialized implant that detects and neutralizes cortex bombs in others
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Semi-independent — recurring contracts with mid-tier fixers

weaknesses: overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots
poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
breaking_points: Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario

physical_description.build: Athletic and lean with dense muscle — dancer's posture married to fighter's tension. Shoulders broad, hips narrow, no excess. Moves like someone who's spent years in close-quarters combat.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with metallic bronze highlights (micro-LED threading)
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid that exposes her neck and jawline
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with undertones suggesting mixed West African and Lusophone heritage
physical_description.complexion: Sharp, angular facial structure — high cheekbones, defined jaw, narrow nose. Skin shows the wear of nocturnal living: faint fatigue lines under eyes, minimal scarring from old street fights. Grooming is functional rather than decorative.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running from left temple to cheekbone, approximately 8cm, barely visible but catches light
Burn scar on inner left wrist, 4cm diameter, from a failed incendiary round ricochet — pale and smooth
Faded tattoo on right shoulder blade: a compass rose in black ink, done by hand in the Narrows
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right forearm features a polished chrome smartgun link port — approximately 12cm of exposed metallic integration at the wrist, with faint neural interface scars radiating upward. The prosthetic is seamless with her skin but unmistakably non-organic. No visible evidence of the cranial bomb defuser, which sits subcutaneous behind her right ear.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight balanced on the balls of her feet — ready to move in any direction instantly. Moves through space economically, no wasted motion. Eyes constantly track exits and threats. At rest, her right hand unconsciously hovers near her forearm. When walking, there's a predatory fluidity — someone comfortable in confined spaces and tight corners.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian. Black synthetic-leather jacket (water-resistant, scored with small cuts and scuffs), fitted enough to move but loose enough to conceal gear. Charcoal tactical pants with reinforced knees and thigh pockets holding small tools and ammunition. Combat boots, black, scuffed. Underneath: a grey undershirt with discreet ballistic weave. No jewelry except a cracked smart-watch on her left wrist (functional, not fashion). All clothing shows the patina of actual use.
